blocks.title: Why open source teams run on Smithers

cards.title: Authenticated cloud MCP
cards.text: Agents create artifacts, draft TODOs, open issues, stack changesets, update wiki pages, and publish audits.

cards.title: One-time sandbox auth
cards.text: Print single-use short-lived tokens for sandboxes and agents. Redeemed atomically once with zero long-lived keys.

cards.title: Lighthouse backpressure
cards.text: Every commit scores against continuous Uphill targets. Untrusted community runs stay isolated from trusted gates.

cards.title: Automatic post-merge
cards.text: Merging from Smithers Cloud to GitHub automatically triggers releases, docs publishing, wiki refresh, and mythical folds.

cards.title: Shared cloud object store
cards.text: Build cache, audit reports, artifacts, wiki snapshots, and changeset stacks share one content-addressed cloud store.

cards.title: Wiki and mythical history
cards.text: Browse an Obsidian-compatible project wiki alongside a clean linear commit narrative verified tree-equal to main.
